And
 In the matter of: Sanjit Das @ Sanjib Das
 ....petitioner.
 Mr. Asfak Ahmmed
 ...for the petitioner.
 Mr. Pravas Bhattacharya
 Ms. Kumkum Mitra

 1.
Heard learned Counsel for both the parties.
2. Learned Counsel for the petitioner does not want to press the anticipatory bail application being CRM (A) 4372 of 2023.
3. Accordingly, CRM (A) 4372 of 2023 is dismissed as not pressed.

(Chitta Ranjan Dash, J.) (Partha Sarathi Sen, J.)
